newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares surge on back of Lek and SKB.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares surge on back of Lek and SKB.

text.p: Slovenian shares surged 2.44 percent on Wednesday, pushed up by strong demand for drug maker Lek and bank SKB.
"I expect very vivacious movement in these two shares over the short term -- the upward trend is most likely to continue," Davor Dubokovic, a trader at Eastbrokers said.
* The 11-share SBI index rose 38.72 points to 1,622.4.
* Bank SKB was the most active, firming 2.67 percent to 76,900 tolars on volume of 3,967 shares.
* Overall 11 shares rose, nine fell and one was unchanged, while four were untraded. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
